title: M3: apricity export --clips: automatic markup of many samples as one browsable folder of clip files
description:
## Purpose

As a beatmaker, I want the automatic markup (sections, loops, one-shots) of many samples exported into one folder of my choosing, laid out for browsing (a folder per sample, a folder per kind), so that I can browse Apricity's markup in the DAW's browser, preview it, and drag a loop straight onto a track, on the grid. This matters most for a library, whose audio sits under `files/audio/<id>/` where browsing beside the sample is useless.

`apricity export --clips <sample or folder>... [-o <folder>] [--library <dir>] [--force]`

## What is shared, and with whom

- The `.alc` writer, the warp map and the **naming rule** belong to the sidecar initiative (apricitus-d7746d): `apricity-daw::names::clip_file_name` (apricitus-998976) gives `<section letter>-<length>-<key> <clip name>.alc`, e.g. `A-1bar-Fm loop-1.alc`, and the `.alc` writer is apricitus-007386. Its M3 (apricitus-f5b805) writes every saved clip **beside its sample** (`export --sidecars`).
- This epic adds only the browsable layout: an output folder anywhere, many samples at once, kind subfolders, automatic markup only, samples from files or a library.

## Scope

- `<out>/<sample>/sections/`, `loops/`, `shots/` (and `holds/`, `phrases/` if the owner includes them, apricitus-e286ad); `<sample>` is the file name without extension, `<recording>-<stem>` for a stem, prefixed by its parent folder when two samples would share a name.
- Each clip file: the sample's audio referenced in place, the region, warp from the manifest, loop on for loops only; built by the shared writer.

## Out of scope

Naming (apricitus-f5b805), your own and curated clips (beside the sample via `export --sidecars`, or a collection in M4), copying audio.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  MF[manifests or library: ML clips] --> K[kind: section / loop / shot]
  K --> L[layout: out/sample/kind/]
  N[names::clip_file_name, apricitus-998976] --> L
  W[.alc writer, apricitus-007386] --> L
  L --> B[the DAW's browser]
```

## Definition of Done

Applies: 1 specs `features/daw/clip-folder.feature` (shared runner and STEPS.md); 2 Rust (`apricity-daw`, `apricity-cli`) and a Python contract test for the kind tags markup writes; 3 schema: the `tags` description of `annotations.clips` documents the kind tags (no structural change); 4 CLI `--clips`; 5 fixtures generated in tests, no audio; 6 `design/daw-presets.md` layout section, `design/vocabulary.md` "clip folder" row; 7 docs/tools.md, docs/concepts.md (Automatic markup), glossary; 8 a `web` need; 9 `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw -p apricity-cli` and `(cd analysis && PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_markup_tags.py)`, plus the manual browse in the DAW; 10 running log; 11 `feat(<task id>)`, not breaking.

## Dependencies

Blocked by M0's decisions (apricitus-e286ad), the naming function (apricitus-998976) and the `.alc` writer (apricitus-007386). Independent of M1 and M2.
